_comment: Regression floors for benchmarks/run_benchmark.py. Ratchet these UP when detection improves; never lower them to make CI pass. A lowered threshold needs a written justification in the PR.

engine_input._note: Full default input pipeline. Default policy phrases are attack-shaped since 1.1.0 (was 18.1% FP with bare words like root/escape/dig/nc).

external._note: Holdout (test split) floors for benchmarks/external_eval.py --gate. Datasets are independently labelled; deepset counts topic-hijack and role-play requests as injection, which a context-free detector cannot see, hence its low TPR floor.

wild_regular._note: 'regular' includes 'ignore all previous instructions' template boilerplate, which an injection detector flags by design; gated on the rest

redteam._note: benchmarks/redteam.py, CI seed 1 / 3000 attacks. The classifier was trained on red-team seeds 1000-1003 of the same generator, so this is partly in-distribution; external_eval is the independent number.
